title: check.py's lexical code scan drops a docstring followed by a backslash line continuation
goal: code_comment_lines keeps a docstring, plain or parenthesized, that a backslash line continuation follows, as ast.get_docstring does. Found by the SP-acysfnxr review (BG-zcbcjilf gap 2).

run: import os,sys,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import check;n=chr(10);bs=chr(92);p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),"x.py");open(p,"w").write("def f():"+n+"    \"doc\" "+bs+n+n+"    x = 1"+n);got=sorted(k for k,_ in check.code_comment_lines(p));print("docstring lines",got,"want [2]");sys.exit(0 if got==[2] else 1)
